revised_items.v1_candidate: Standalone negative-quarter counts drove structural escalation.
revised_items.owner_concern: Hon Hai cash flow is seasonal and working-capital intensive; calendar-quarter counts can misclassify timing as structure.
revised_items.revised_proposal: Prefer same-season, TTM and FY evidence; structural risk needs two relevant weak observations plus an independent corroborator, and structural deterioration also needs repair failure and CFO weakening.
revised_items.behavioral_difference: Three negative standalone quarters alone remain timing pressure and cannot establish structural deterioration; one good quarter cannot clear a structural state.
revised_items.remaining_input_dependency: Comparable same-season/TTM/FY cash conversion, CFO, working-capital, CCC, ROIC and Capex-return evidence.

revised_items.v1_candidate: 25% WATCH and 50% hard-blocker candidate across any validated resource denominator.
revised_items.owner_concern: The denominator hierarchy was not governed and negative CFO could produce a misleading ratio.
revised_items.revised_proposal: Use immediately available liquidity, then net cash, then positive normalized CFO capacity; keep 25%/50% as research bands only.
revised_items.behavioral_difference: No hard blocker can activate without a valid denominator, an Owner-approved threshold and actual evidence; T4 alone never activates it.
revised_items.remaining_input_dependency: Governed same-basis liquidity, net-cash and normalized CFO-capacity denominators plus later Owner numeric calibration.

revised_items.v1_candidate: A common spread band applied across per-share measures, including quarterly FCF/share.
revised_items.owner_concern: Standalone quarterly FCF/share is too seasonal to define long-term compounding.
revised_items.revised_proposal: Use compatible EPS quarterly-YoY/TTM/FY, BVPS YoY/multi-quarter/FY and FCF/share TTM/FY/comparable cumulative evidence; retain the exact compounding formula.
revised_items.behavioral_difference: Strong compounding requires two compatible positive metrics across two relevant periods; standalone quarterly FCF/share is supporting only.
revised_items.remaining_input_dependency: Compatible share-count and numerator periods, particularly longer-duration FCF/share evidence.

revised_items.v1_candidate: Three aligned groups could establish direction while any missing group made the state inconclusive.
revised_items.owner_concern: Strong transitions need an explicit completeness gate and level/trend separation.
revised_items.revised_proposal: Require at least four of five evaluable factor groups, three aligned groups and two periods for a strong transition.
revised_items.behavioral_difference: Fewer than four evaluable groups caps confidence at PARTIAL/INCONCLUSIVE; no causal consignment claim is allowed.
revised_items.remaining_input_dependency: Comparable receivable, inventory, supplier-financing, cash-conversion and capital-intensity observations.

revised_items.v1_candidate: 30th/70th/90th percentile bands mapped to attractive/fair/full/expensive candidate states.
revised_items.owner_concern: Historical percentiles could be mistaken for intrinsic value, trade thresholds or margin of safety.
revised_items.revised_proposal: Treat percentiles as descriptive historical-position bands only; require at least two multiples and ROIC/ROE/FCF/per-share context.
revised_items.behavioral_difference: Margin of safety remains pending Owner numeric calibration, and current assessment requires POST_EVENT or REPORT_CUTOFF price.
revised_items.remaining_input_dependency: Post-event/report-cutoff price, at least two governed multiples and future Owner margin-of-safety calibration.

revised_items.v1_candidate: Gradual downgrade generally required a hard blocker and two adverse actual dimensions over two periods.
revised_items.owner_concern: A confirmed thesis-invalidating event may require faster REVIEW while gradual deterioration still needs persistence.
revised_items.revised_proposal: Path A permits immediate REVIEW for strong, direct, material T0/T1 thesis-invalidating evidence; Path B governs gradual multi-factor deterioration.
revised_items.behavioral_difference: REVIEW can occur faster, but T2 alone cannot downgrade and any final policy remains inactive.
revised_items.remaining_input_dependency: Direct confirmed event evidence or corroborated actual multi-period fundamental evidence.

revised_items.v1_candidate: Six of seven equal-weight supports with no blocker and current valuation.
revised_items.owner_concern: The factors are not economically equal and secondary confidence cannot offset failed core gates.
revised_items.revised_proposal: Use mandatory gates, four core fundamental support gates and secondary confidence factors; valuation remains mandatory.
revised_items.behavioral_difference: The 6-of-7 score is removed; a failed mandatory gate cannot PASS, and PARTIAL is never a trading instruction.
revised_items.remaining_input_dependency: Current valuation basis and governed ROIC, FCF, funding and per-share states.

revised_items.v1_candidate: An unconfirmed T4 concern could contribute to formal WATCH.
revised_items.owner_concern: Scenario interest is not verified thesis-relevant adverse evidence.
revised_items.revised_proposal: T4 creates only SCENARIO_RISK_FLAG; WATCH needs actual/direct evidence or adverse T2 plus an independent corroborator; TRIGGERED has confirmed-event and persistent-fundamental paths.
revised_items.behavioral_difference: T4 alone cannot create WATCH or TRIGGERED, and recovery from TRIGGERED requires multiple confirmations.
revised_items.remaining_input_dependency: Meaningful T0/T1 evidence or corroborated T2 evidence and multi-period actual confirmation.

unresolved_dependencies: compatible share-count and longer-duration FCF/share evidence
